title: HHHusher line reveal
description: Big text given line by line. On wide screens each line rises into place and fades in as it scrolls into view, later lines a little later and from further down; on phones the lines flow as one paragraph and fade in one after another.
notes: CSS scroll-driven (animation-timeline: view()); without support or with reduced motion the text simply shows
pass the lines as they break at 1440px; style the size through className
